title: TIER/Dott Pricing Plan
description: A per-city, per-vehicle-type pricing plan as published in the Dott GBFS 2.3 system_pricing_plans feed.

plan_id.description: Stable UUID identifying the plan within the city/system.

description.description: Free-text description (typically: `Riders pay X EUR to unlock and Y EUR per minute.`).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. EUR, GBP, SEK, AED, ILS).

price.description: Unlock price charged once per ride.

is_taxable.description: Whether the plan price is taxable.

interval.description: Length of each pricing step in minutes.

rate.description: Cost per step in the plan's currency.

start.description: Minute at which this tier becomes active.
